questions.question: What does chapter 11 describe?
options: Joshua's conquest of the northern kings
The crossing of the Jordan River on dry ground
Achan's hidden sin and its punishment
The fall of Jericho's encircling walls
questions.answer: Joshua's conquest of the northern kings
